name: Section Library
summary: Shopify app that adds 200+ ready-made theme sections plus AI-generated custom ones (Gemini 3.1 Pro), all inside the native theme editor so layouts change without a developer. Live since October 2023 with a single App Store review.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want ready-made theme sections and the occasional AI-generated layout inside the native theme editor, and who can live with an app that has almost no public track record
skip_if: you are rebuilding a store you cannot afford to break and want a page builder with thousands of merchants behind it, or you need your monthly cost known in advance: the credit unit is never defined
honest_knock:
Almost three years on the App Store and one review. The app launched 10 October 2023 and, as of 5 October 2026, exactly one merchant has written about it: a five-star note from October 2023 by someone who had it installed for four minutes. That is not evidence of quality and not evidence of trouble: it is an absence of evidence, and on an app that writes sections into your live theme, that absence is the main thing to weigh. On the same listing page Shopify shows Section Store with 2,967 reviews (read 5 October 2026), also free to install, which is what a track record looks like in this category. The old site, sectionlibrary.com, still answers with Shopify’s “Store unavailable” page (17 September, 5 October and 12 November 2026); the product now lives at optifyapps.com/mason under its new name, Mason.

Second, the credit is defined only inside the app. Every plan is priced in credits and nothing on the listing says what one buys; the app's own price list says a full AI page is 5 credits, an AI section 1, an AI edit 0.5 and a library section 5 credits once, so you only learn the rates after you have installed it.

Third, the AI half of the product is Google's. The October listing named Gemini 3.1 Pro, and the Mason privacy policy (effective 24 October 2026) says prompts, the detected brand kit and the relevant theme content go to third-party AI model providers such as Google's Gemini models, so output quality and consistency shift when Google ships a new model, which is outside the vendor's hands as much as yours. The library half, the 200+ pre-built sections, is the part that depends on nobody else, and it is the part worth judging the app on.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 25 credits and access to the full section library, billed every 30 days in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on apps.shopify.com/mason and in our own test that day; earlier: re-read 2026-09-17, 2026-10-05 and 2026-11-12 on apps.shopify.com/section-library; listed in October as “Section Library: AI Sections” and on 12 November 2026 as “Mason: AI Page Builder”; every amount is unchanged since 19 August 2026) Free plan: 8 credits a month, access to the free sections only, basic AI generation. Starter $9 a month: 25 credits, all sections accessible, AI section generation, email support. Pro $19 a month: 55 credits, all sections, priority support. Business $29 a month: 90 credits, all sections, priority support. All charges are billed in USD and recur every 30 days, and the listing shows no free trial on the paid tiers — the free plan is the trial. The pricing table on the listing still never states what a credit buys: whether one credit is one AI generation, one section added to a theme, or something else is defined nowhere on it, and the credit count is the only thing separating the four plans. The app itself does say, on its home screen and plans page (our own test of 17 November 2026): a full AI page costs 5 credits, an AI section 1 credit, an AI edit 0.5 credits, and a library section costs 5 credits once, after which reinstalling and customizing it are free. The old site, sectionlibrary.com, answered HTTP 402 with Shopify’s “Store unavailable” page on 17 September, 5 October and 12 November 2026. The product now has a page at optifyapps.com/mason (read 12 November 2026), which says Section Library is now Mason: the same app from the same team, repositioned as an AI page builder that generates full pages and custom sections from a prompt on top of the section library. That page repeats the free plan (8 AI credits a month) and paid plans from $9, and it does not define a credit either. Developer Optify, 16 Rue Cuvier, Lyon, France; the app launched 10 October 2023. It still carries a 5.0 rating from exactly one App Store review, left in October 2023 by a merchant who had the app installed for four minutes; still the only review on 12 November 2026. Read again on 17 November 2026: the listing (apps.shopify.com/section-library now redirects to apps.shopify.com/mason; the title is Mason: AI Page Builder, formerly Section Library) shows the same amounts, Free 8 credits, Starter $9 for 25, Pro $19 for 55 and Business $29 for 90, with no trial on the paid plans and still one review, five stars, from October 2023. In our own test the same day on a Shopify development store the app, named Mason in the install dialog and in the admin, opened on its Free plan with 8 credits, no card and no plan choice. The listing says the Free plan has access to free sections only; in the app the Free plan showed library access, but the one library section we installed cost 5 of the 8 credits and we saw none marked free, though we did not open them all. The plans page showed Starter at about 5 AI pages a month, Pro about 11 and Business about 18. Choosing Starter opened Shopify's approval screen: $9.00 every 30 days, with the line “You will not be billed for this test charge” and an Add payment method row, so we did not approve it.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Mason (formerly Section Library) on a Shopify development store: the redirect from the old listing, the install without a payment screen on the free plan with 8 credits, one library section (Trust Badges) installed for 5 credits that stood in an unsaved theme preview about 6 minutes and about 10 steps after the start, the 3 credits left, the plan page with $9, $19 and $29 and the credit prices that the listing does not name, the Starter approval screen (not approved) and the uninstall, which asks for a reason. The app wrote a section file into the live theme and offered no removal. Nothing was paid or saved. Name: apps.shopify.com/section-library now redirects to apps.shopify.com/mason, titled Mason: AI Page Builder (developer Optify). In the install dialog and in the app it is called Mason. It is the same product as the Section Library of the dossier (200+ ready-made sections) with AI pages and AI sections added, so the review should read Mason, formerly Section Library. The listing shows Free plan available and a rating of 5.0 from 1 review (27 Oct 2023), launched on 10 Oct 2023. Install: the install form was sent in our own tab at about 23:09 and Install was clicked on the permission screen (View staff and contributor data, View and edit store data: Products, Online Store). No payment screen came up; the app opened on its Home page on the free plan with 8 credits left, Free plan, resets Dec 17, 2026, and prices of Page 5 credits, Section 1 credit and AI edit 0.5 credits. Setup guide 0 of 3 done. Core action: Browse the library shows cards with 5 credits on every section (for example Product Spotlight, Shoppable Hotspots, Countdown Offer, Trust Badges, Comparison Table, Press Logo Marquee). Trust Badges has the buttons Customize with AI and Install, and Details 5 credits. Install opened the dialog Install Trust Badges with Theme test-data (Live) and the text Installing costs 5 credits once. After that, reinstalling and customizing are free. After Install the app said Installed on test-data. In the theme editor, click Add section to use it., and the details showed Owned. Home then said 3 credits left (8 minus 5). In our own tab the theme editor (Template, Add section, search Trust) offered Mason - Trust Badges with a preview; it was added and showed four badges. The theme was not saved; the section was removed again with undo. About 6 minutes and about 10 clicks after the start (about 23:09) the section stood in the unsaved preview, with no code written. Difference with the listing: the listing says the Free plan gives Access to free sections. In the app every library section we saw cost 5 of the 8 free credits and we did not see a free one (not all were looked at). After one section 3 credits were left, so a second library section does not fit on the free plan. Credit prices (page 5, AI section 1, AI edit 0.5) are shown in the app only; the listing does not name them. Side effect: the install dialog chose the theme test-data (Live) and no draft theme was offered (the drop-down was not opened). The app wrote the section as a theme file, Mason - Trust Badges, in the live theme even though the page was never saved, and the app did not offer to remove it. After uninstalling the file may stay in the theme; that was not checked. Plans: Plans & credits shows Free $0 a month (8 credits, AI pages and sections, Import your own sections, Library access), Starter $9 a month (25 credits, about 5 AI pages a month, Unlimited imports), Pro $19 a month (55 credits, about 11 AI pages a month) and Business $29 a month (90 credits, about 18 AI pages a month), equal to the dossier and the listing. The listing says all charges are billed in USD and that recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days. Checkout: Choose Starter opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: Mason by Optify, plan Starter, $9,00 USD every 30 days, subtotal $9,00 plus any applicable taxes, total due 17 Nov $9,00, and a yellow bar You will not be billed for this test charge., but also a row Add payment method. Under our strict rule (a payment method row means a real card) we did not approve and clicked Cancel; Shopify then showed Charge declined. No card was entered. Cancelling: no paid plan was started, so no cancel button in the app was looked for. Settings, Apps, the app menu and Uninstall opened the dialog Uninstall Mason? (you will no longer be able to use the app; data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted) with a required Reason for uninstalling (options include Testing multiple apps, Too expensive and Other) and an optional Share feedback box (0/250); Testing multiple apps was chosen and the app then left the Installed list. Not tested: an AI section or AI page (1 and 5 credits), Brand kit, importing our own sections, Pages, installing on a draft theme, the storefront itself (it has a password), a paid plan and paid credits, whether any library section is free, and whether the section files stay in the theme after uninstalling. Clean up: the theme was not saved and the section was removed in the editor with undo; the section file Mason - Trust Badges was written to the live theme and was not removed separately. No subscription was approved. Mason was uninstalled. Other apps were not touched and our own tab was closed. The price fields are not changed here. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The old name no longer appears: the app is Mason now. The listing says the Free plan has access to free sections, but every library section we saw costs 5 of the 8 free credits, so one section uses most of a month. The install went to the live theme with no draft choice visible, and the section file stays in the theme even when the page is not saved. The credit prices are only visible in the app.
